sources.title: Missale secundum morem ecclesie Cesaraugustane, Zaragoza: Paulus Hurus 1498, Toledo BCLM Inc. 248 (Patrimonio Digital CLM registro 12263)
sources.inspection: Page images viewed 2026-10-21: position 5 title with manuscript note dating the book 1498 under Archbishop Alfonso de Aragón; position 6 Festivitates colende in diocesi Cesaraugustana; position 7 January calendar; position 727 (f. CXXXV) colophon naming the reigning archbishop Alfonso de Aragón, the book carefully emended and printed at Zaragoza at Paul Hurus's order and expense, nono kalendas Decembris 1498.
sources.limitations: Selected leaves only; GW M24305 / ISTC im00653150 / IBE 3964 identity from catalogues. CC BY images retained in scratch only. No episcopal mandate leaf seen; the emendation phrase is the colophon's.

sources.title: Missale Cesaraugustanum, Zaragoza: Georgius Coci, colophon 1522 (Universidad de Zaragoza H-1-152, Zaguán record 74837)
sources.inspection: Whole 613-page CC BY 4.0 PDF acquired 2026-10-21; PDF p. 8 title with archiepiscopal arms; p. 9 Juan Sobrarias's letter to Archbishop Juan de Aragón dated xii kal. Aprilis 1522, saying the archbishop had the diocesan books, especially breviary and missal, made most correct and the chapter gave them, put in order and 'most closely joined' (coniunctissimos) to the holy Roman church, to Georgius Coci to print, followed by Festivitates colende in diocesi Cesaraugustana; p. 606 colophon: printed in Coci's shop in 1522, xv kalendas martias.
sources.limitations: The holding record dates this copy 1540 (citing Sánchez 224) with [48], CCLXXVI leaves, while CCPB000017862-4 records the 1522 Coci edition as 17 + 310 leaves; copy-to-edition identity is unresolved. Body text not collated.

sources.title: Missale iuxta ritum Alme Ecclesie Valentine, Venice: Luca Antonio Giunta for Mateo de Monteacuto 1509 (Universitat de València, Roderic hdl 10550/7813)
sources.inspection: Images from the repository's public image directory (record b14499423) viewed 2026-10-21: 0002 title; 0004 January calendar (8 January row blank; 27 January John Chrysostom commemoration; 30 January Valerius); 0727 (f. CCCLVIv) colophon, Venice, 19 May 1509 (xiiij cal. Junii), at the Valencian bookseller's expense, for the observance of the Valencian see; 0727–0730 table (temporal part on 0727) naming the cathedral altar dedication, the Guardian Angel of the kingdom and city, and a votive Mass of the Holy Name.
sources.limitations: Low-resolution images; selected leaves only. Collation [10], CCCLVIII f. per the repository; shelfmark not displayed. No bishop named in the leaves seen.

sources.title: Missale secundum ritum insignis ecclesie Valentine, Zaragoza: Georgius Coci 1528 (Universitat de València BH R-2/150–152, Roderic hdl 10550/52560)
sources.inspection: Images (record b13937431) viewed 2026-10-21: 0001 title in architectural border; 0003 January calendar (8 January De nomine Iesu, double; 27 January blank; 30 January Valerius double); 0532 colophon, Zaragoza, Georgius Coci, 1528, for the observance of the Valencian cathedral, with day formula calendas apriles quarto et vicesimo; table 0528–0532, with 0528 placing De nomine Iesu (f. xij) in the temporal after Epiphany.
sources.limitations: Low-resolution images; selected leaves only. The colophon day formula is ambiguous. No bishop named in the leaves seen.

stages.label: 1498 Zaragoza missal (Hurus, quarto)
stages.scope: An exact Zaragoza-use missal copy with original title, diocesan holy-day list, January calendar and colophon inspected.
stages.witness_label: Missale secundum morem ecclesie Cesaraugustane, Zaragoza: Paulus Hurus 1498, Toledo BCLM Inc. 248
stages.summary: The title names the Zaragoza church's use; the colophon dates completion to 23 November 1498 under Archbishop Alfonso de Aragón, describes the book as carefully emended and printed at Paul Hurus's order and expense, and the front matter lists the diocese's holy days of obligation.

evidence.claim: Zaragoza use; 23 November 1498; reigning archbishop; emendation statement; Hurus imprint.
Diocesan holy-day list without St Matthias or St Barnabas.

stages.limitations: Selected leaves only. The colophon's emendation phrase names no exemplar; no predecessor comparison with Zaragoza 1485 is possible from the defective Barcelona copy. No separate episcopal mandate seen.
stages.reception: A diocesan-use book printed under the archbishop; use in particular churches is not established.

stages.label: 1522 Zaragoza missal (Coci), corrected under Archbishop Juan de Aragón
stages.date_label: 15 February 1522 colophon; preface letter 21 March 1522; holding catalogue dates the copy 1540
stages.scope: An exact Zaragoza-use missal copy with original title, preface letter, holy-day list and colophon inspected; its printing date is disputed between the colophon and the holding catalogue.
stages.witness_label: Missale Cesaraugustanum, Coci, Universidad de Zaragoza H-1-152
stages.summary: The preface letter states that Archbishop Juan de Aragón had the diocesan breviary and missal corrected and that the chapter gave the corrected books, set in order and 'most closely joined' (coniunctissimos) to the holy Roman church, to Georgius Coci to print. The colophon dates the printing to 1522; the holy-day list adds St Matthias and St Barnabas to those of 1498.

evidence.locus: PDF p. 8 title; p. 9 letter and Festivitates colende; p. 606 colophon
evidence.claim: Archiepiscopal correction and chapter commissioning; 1522 colophon; diocesan holy days including Matthias and Barnabas.

stages.limitations: The bounds 1522–1540 express the unresolved conflict between the copy's colophon and the library's 1540 dating; they are not a period of use. The letter, a humanist's address to the archbishop rather than a mandate, describes correction in general terms; its coniunctissimos phrase does not establish textual conformity to the Roman Missal. Only the holy-day list is compared with 1498. A 1573 manuscript note shows possession, not celebration.
stages.reception: Chapter-commissioned diocesan book under the archbishop; parish reception not established.

stages.label: 1509 Valencia missal (Venice, Giunta)
stages.scope: An exact Valencia-use missal copy with original title, January calendar, colophon and table inspected.
stages.witness_label: Missale iuxta ritum Alme Ecclesie Valentine, Venice: L. A. Giunta for M. de Monteacuto 1509 (Roderic 10550/7813)
stages.summary: The title and colophon name the Valencian church's rite and see; printed at Venice for a Valencian bookseller on 19 May 1509. The calendar keeps Valerius and an octave of Vincent; the table lists the cathedral altar dedication, the Guardian Angel of the kingdom and city, and only a votive Mass of the Holy Name.

evidence.claim: Valencian use and 19 May 1509 Venice printing.
January entries (8 January blank, 27 January Chrysostom) and local feasts.

stages.limitations: Selected leaves only; low-resolution images. No episcopal authority leaf seen. Copy identity with catalogue copies BH R-1/018 and Biblioteca de Catalunya 1 VI 26 is not checked.
stages.reception: Printed for the observance of the Valencian see by a Valencian bookseller; church-level use not established.

stages.label: 1528 Valencia missal (Zaragoza, Coci)
stages.scope: An exact Valencia-use missal copy with original title, January calendar, colophon and table inspected.
stages.witness_label: Missale secundum ritum insignis ecclesie Valentine, Zaragoza: G. Coci 1528 (Roderic 10550/52560)
stages.summary: Title and colophon name the Valencian cathedral's rite; printed by Coci at Zaragoza in 1528. The calendar assigns 8 January to the Holy Name as a double and the table places it in the temporal after Epiphany.

evidence.claim: 8 January Holy Name double; 27 January row blank.

stages.limitations: Selected leaves only; colophon day uncertain. No episcopal authority leaf seen.
stages.reception: Printed for the observance of the Valencian cathedral; church-level use not established.

transitions.summary: The diocesan list of holy days printed in the front matter gains St Matthias and St Barnabas between the 1498 and 1522 Zaragoza missals.

changes.before: Festivitates colende list without St Matthias or St Barnabas.
changes.after: Festivitates colende list adds St Matthias (after the Purification) and St Barnabas (after Corpus Christi); the other entries and the parish-patron clause recur.

evidence.claim: The 1522 book presents itself as corrected under the archbishop.

transitions.limitations: Only the holy-day list is collated; intervening printings are unchecked, so the change is bounded between these two books, not dated. No direct exemplar relation between the two printings is established.

transitions.summary: Two January calendar rows differ between the 1509 and 1528 Valencia missals: the Holy Name enters on 8 January and the 27 January Chrysostom commemoration is absent.

evidence.locus: table image 0528 (temporal, De nomine Iesu f. xij)
evidence.claim: The 1528 table places the Holy Name in the temporal after Epiphany, where the 1509 table lists only a votive Mass.

evidence.locus: table images 0727 (temporal part) and 0730 (Missa de nomine Iesu, f. 321)
evidence.claim: The 1509 temporal table has no Holy Name entry; the Holy Name appears only as a votive Mass.

transitions.limitations: Only the January calendar page and the tables are compared; the 1509 and 1528 books come from different printers (Venice, Zaragoza) and no exemplar relation is established. The Chrysostom commemoration may stand elsewhere in 1528; only its absence from this row is recorded.

gaps.missing: Zaragoza 1485 (GW M24301; BC Res. 700-Fol. lacks calendar, title, colophon and the opening and closing gatherings) cannot supply a dated first state; the 1522/1540 dating of BUZ H-1-152 is unresolved; the 1531, 1540, 1552 Bernuz (Zaguán 3148, incomplete DjVu) and 1598 printings, Roman adoption and actual reception are uninspected; only the holy-day list is collated.
gaps.next_source: Another 1485 copy (Ripoll, Teruel or Zaragoza cathedral) with title and colophon; CCPB000017862-4 1522 copies to settle the 1522/1540 question; Zaguán 3148 (1552); the archdiocese's adoption of the Roman Missal.
gaps.consequence: Two dated states and one bounded calendar change; no continuous sequence or Roman-adoption date is plotted.

gaps.missing: The 1492 Venice incunable (GW M24827; BNE digital copy behind a security challenge) is unseen; episcopal authority for 1509 and 1528; later printings and the Roman adoption; component collation beyond the January calendar.
gaps.next_source: BNE bdh 0000098925 or Valencia BH Inc. 015 copy of 1492; Esteve Forriol, Bibliofilia Antigua 1 (1992) 91–117; Valencian synodal and chapter records.
gaps.consequence: Two dated states and one bounded calendar change; no 1492 state or Roman adoption is plotted.

gaps.missing: Original leaves of the 1499 Rosembach missal (GW M24774; BVPB 397105 copy, Tarragona Biblioteca Pública I/132, unreachable: HTTP 429 throughout 2026-10-21; only a cached thumbnail of f. XI seen) and of the 1550 Lyon Septgranges printing (CCPB001399849-8; candidate iberian-tarragona-1550); title, colophon, archiepiscopal authority and reception.
gaps.next_source: Retry BVPB grupo path 11000715; Hispanic Society and Tarragona cathedral copies; the Girona seminary copy of 1550.
gaps.consequence: No Tarragona stage is documented; candidates remain catalogue witnesses.

gaps.missing: No Urgell incunable is recorded in GW (Ucetiense M24821 is followed by Upsalense M24824); CCPB, Memòria Digital de Catalunya, Europeana and Zaguán returned none; the existing 1536 and 1557 candidates are uninspected; printed missals of 1509 and 1527 reported in the Seu d'Urgell chapter archive have unspecified use.
gaps.next_source: Seu d'Urgell chapter archive inventory (IEC chronicle, Pujol report p. 837); USTC/Amiet copies of the 1536 and 1557 printings.
gaps.consequence: No Urgell stage is documented; absence from these repertories does not show that no Urgell missal was printed.
